title: 第19章 力所能及请卸甲二阶御兽师第20章 精英级白光蝶盗蛋隐蜥
slug: 御兽开局炼妖壶吞噬就变强
lines: “力所能及…当真？”
夜玄玩味一笑，目光饶有兴趣打量面前少女。
孙雨棠被盯的有些忐忑，只觉得眼前青年仿佛头饥渴饿狼，随时都有可能吃掉自己。
她手掌抱怀，下意识后退半步。
“卸甲。”
“夜少，我…”
孙雨棠瞬间面红耳赤，心生慌乱。
“卸甲。”
夜玄面无表情，像是在阐述某种再正常不过的事情。
饿了吃饭，有压力就释放，人之常情，很简单。
“孙雨棠，打从踏入房门一刻起，不就已经打定主意要讨好我了？你是在担心我会将你弃之不顾，当做随手可弃的棋子。”
稍作停顿，夜玄冷笑道：“不过说来也有趣。”
“这个下作主意...该不会是鹿二发给你出的？”
夜玄一双黑眸犀利如刀，当场刺穿少女内心，令她下意识回应，心中羞愧难当。
“卸甲。”
孙雨棠螓首低垂，她笨拙的解着脑后发簪。
半个时辰过去，夜玄推门走出。
“夜少，嘿嘿…”
远处，鹿二发嘿嘿怪笑，跟个狗腿似的跑过来大献殷勤。
夜玄一翻白眼，拍了拍鹿二发肩膀，走向一棵树下。
盘膝而坐，压力得到释放，夜玄的心宁静不少。
他默默摄取炼妖壶内的灵力，潜心静修。
见夜玄入定修炼，鹿二发没有打扰，笑着转身离去，尝试与老狒王大壮拉近关系…
时间流逝。
凭借炼妖壶内精纯灵气，夜玄境界再次节节暴涨。
一阶七星…
一阶八星…
一阶九星…
一阶十星…
下午末时，当榨干炼妖壶内最后一缕灵气，夜玄一鼓作气，成功踏入二阶御兽师行列！
一圈气浪以盘坐的夜玄为中心，向四周扩散。
横扫大片落叶。
其突破速度之快，若是让他人知晓，定会目瞪口呆，惊掉下巴！
境界突破，兽契限制得到解放，护在夜玄身边的夜狩猛然睁眼，水到渠成突破二阶一星。

"As much as we can...seriously?"
Ye Xuan smiled playfully and looked at the girl in front of him with interest.
Sun Yutang was a little uneasy being stared at, and felt that the young man in front of him was like a hungry wolf that might eat him at any time.
She held her arms in her arms and subconsciously took a half step back.
"Remove armor."
"Young Master Ye, I..."
Sun Yutang instantly turned red and panicked.
"Remove armor."
Ye Xuan's face was expressionless, as if he was explaining something completely normal.
Eat when you are hungry and release stress. It is human nature and very simple.
"Sun Yutang, from the moment you stepped into the door, weren't you already determined to please me? You were worried that I would abandon you and treat you as a disposable pawn."
After a short pause, Ye Xuan sneered and said, "But it's interesting to say."
"This is a random idea...could it be Lu Erfa who came up with it for you?"
"Yes, yes..."
Ye Xuan's black eyes were as sharp as a knife, piercing the girl's heart on the spot, causing her to respond subconsciously, feeling ashamed in her heart.
"Remove armor."
"Yes..."
Sun Yutang lowered her head and awkwardly untied the hairpin on the back of her head.
“…”
Half an hour later, Ye Xuan opened the door and walked out.
"Young Master Ye, hehe..."
In the distance, Lu Erfa laughed strangely and ran over like a dog to show his hospitality.
Ye Xuan rolled his eyes, patted Lu Erfa on the shoulder, and walked towards a tree.
Sitting cross-legged, the pressure was released, and Ye Xuan felt much calmer.
He silently absorbed the spiritual power in the demon refining pot and concentrated on meditation.
Seeing Ye Xuan entering meditation practice, Lu Erfa did not disturb him, turned around and left with a smile, trying to get closer to the old baboon king Da Zhuang...
Time passes.
With the pure spiritual energy in the demon refining pot, Ye Xuan's realm has skyrocketed again.
First level seven stars…
First level eight stars…
First level nine stars…
First level ten stars…
At the end of the afternoon, when the last ray of spiritual energy was squeezed out of the demon refining pot, Ye Xuan worked hard and successfully entered the ranks of second-level beast masters!
"Boom!"
A circle of air waves centered on Ye Xuan, who was sitting cross-legged, and spread to all sides.
Sweeping across the vast swaths of fallen leaves.
Its breakthrough speed is so fast that if others knew about it, they would be stunned and their jaws would drop!
The realm was broken through, and the restrictions of the beast contract were released. Ye Shou, who was guarding Ye Xuan, suddenly opened his eyes, and it was easy to break through to the second level and one star.
